How to Apply
Applying to the PhD program in Chemistry
To apply to the Graduate Program in Chemistry please go to: https://applygrad.missouri.edu/apply/
Results of GRE General or Chemistry Subject Exam scores may be provided, but are NOT required.
Applicants from countries where the primary first language is not English must provide results of the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL). The recommended minimum scores are (approximately): TOEFL IBT–92 or IELTS–6.5/7 or Duolingo–115.
Applications for the typical August start in the PhD program will be reviewed as they are received throughout the Spring semester and applicants will be notified of the decision as soon as possible. Applications to begin the program in January will also be considered and will be reviewed as they are received.
If you are a prospective graduate student and would like to visit our department, please contact Jerry Brightwell at brightwellj@missouri.edu or gradchem@missouri.edu or by phone at 573-884-6832.
